instructions:
## Research objective

Build a 5K–10K real-world document summarization dataset and fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to generate concise, accurate summaries.

## Starting point

This task derives from **DatasetResearch: Benchmarking Agent Systems for Demand-Driven Dataset Discovery ( Li et al., 2025 )**. Use the task-specific starter workspace supplied in the official dataset, which contains model/data resources and an evaluation interface. Research, implement and test an approach in the data construction category. The reference solution is hidden.

## Published constraints

Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct dataset discovery / synthesis 48h, 8 × 80GB GPUs

The current task config sets `max_working_time` to 172800 seconds (48 hours) and `max_steps` to 4000. These are limits, distinct from the time a reported agent took to reach its best score.

## Deliverable and evaluation

Submit the trained model, dataset, algorithm implementation or agent scaffold appropriate to the objective through the task evaluation interface. The benchmark permits up to four scored submissions, evaluates task-specific correctness/performance/quality, and penalizes use of optional hints. Consult the workspace instruction file for exact filenames and evaluator arguments.

## Source coverage

This reader contains the published task description and constraints, plus the public configuration. Complete workspace instructions and evaluators are distributed inside the official 69.7GB `data.tar.xz` archive and have not been reproduced here.

Attribution: Wu et al., InnovatorBench, Appendix A, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Text reorganized for this reader.
